question: Can numerically routed fixed-capacity synaptic storage retain imperfect independently constructed operations through sequential acquisition, cold restart, full-capacity rejection and a localized repair?
hypothesis: Across8 fixed banks holding32 independently acquired operations, all previously stored outputs remain byte/execution-identical after each later acquisition and after repairing key1. All32 operations cold-restore correctly, unknown keys abstain, and every full-bank fifth acquisition is rejected without changing any synapse. This is bounded retention/reuse support, not improved construction accuracy or superior intelligence.

frozen_design.data: For each signature/seed, unchanged WSP15 strict construction1024 proposals on5 observations, then unchanged WSP16 neutral adaptation1024 proposals after adversarial context3 witness. Do not filter poorly fitted operations. All original prediction errors remain reportable.
frozen_design.bank: Four slots, each75 binary NAND connectivity scalars, three binary key synapses and one occupancy bit:316 binary scalars. Numeric equality/first-free threshold gates select the slot and masked numerical writes update it. No Python dictionary/task-program lookup inside the candidate. Task key is explicitly supplied context, not inferred task identity. JSON serialization is checkpoint transport only.
frozen_design.repair: After all4 operations are stored, retrieve key1 numerically and run1024 neutral proposals on its original5 observations plus a new context3 label opposite its present prediction. Numeric replace on key1 must leave the other3 operations byte-identical. Whether the repaired key recovers its witness is measured and not assumed; retention is not successful rule discovery.
frozen_design.capacity: 8 banks x4 stored tasks; fixed4slots throughout; no growth, hidden external fallback or eviction. Fifth acquisition may only reject.32 gradients-free acquired graphs plus8 repair attempts. All externally replayed6-example buffers and316 binary resident scalars are counted.
frozen_design.hidden: All8 context outputs checked for stored-program execution identity, not scored as novel generalization. Uniform hidden ambiguity in predecessors remains unchanged.
frozen_design.stop: Fixed proposals/counts,30minute hosted timeout; no threshold,seed,capacity or cohort changes after results

controls.symbolic_storage: Independent fixed-capacity dictionary of the exact same acquired outputs, four entries maximum; identical source information and key interface. Expected execution/retention tie, not a superiority claim.
controls.single_slot: One acquired graph overwritten sequentially; task key ignored. Same acquired graphs/data, explicitly ONE QUARTER candidate graph capacity. Report actual output interference, not use as a matched-capacity superiority claim.
controls.trained_replay: Separate eight-logit Adam learner per key, replay all6 actual observed outcomes, convergence BCE<=.02/max2048 steps using unchanged WSP16 conventional trainer.4x8 conventional floating scalars, same external task-key routing; note capacity/representation mismatch.32 acquisitions plus8 repair fits must converge; scores measured versus known observations, no hidden labels.
controls.erased: Clear occupancy and all key/program synapses, every requested known key must abstain
controls.unknown: Unseen keys4..7 must abstain before and after full-bank rejection
controls.corrupt: Truncated/checksum/schema/canonical uniqueness/occupancy violations rejected even with a forged valid digest

metrics: numeric-route vs independent symbolic output agreement

classification_rules.dev_supported: All sequential/cold/collateral comparisons exact,8/8 full-capacity rejections preserve state,32 stored operations survive cold and erasure controls effective. Symbolic storage must tie.
classification_rules.negative: Any frozen retention/routing/capacity threshold missed with valid controls
classification_rules.tie: Exact symbolic storage ties all retention/execution metrics; report TIE for bounded storage, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Unavailable without stronger independently qualified matched control; no protected independent first-use authorized
classification_rules.invalid: External candidate task dictionary/slot selection, hidden target leaks, source/custody/control defects or post-result changes

qualification: Remote prereg commit before implementation and primary evaluation. Final exact SHA/tree full original+WSP01-17 unit regression, frozen WSP17 DEV, source integrity/permanent G29 on GitHub-hosted Windows2022 and Ubuntu. Reuse predecessor DEV only for byte-identical immutable inputs/source. No merge/promotion/deployment.
